name: Paramecia mastery
description: A superhuman property of the body, or power over something: Intellect speeds the insight.

stages.name: Basic control
stages.description: Use the power on purpose, a little.
stages.text: You did it on purpose for the first time.

stages.name: First techniques
stages.description: Shape the power into moves of your own.
stages.text: The power did what you asked, and you gave the move a name.

stages.name: A combat style
stages.description: Build a way of fighting around the power.
stages.text: You stopped fighting with the power and started fighting through it.

stages.name: Haki synergy
stages.text: Your power and your will moved together.

stages.name: Creative leaps
stages.text: You found a use for the power nobody had ever thought of.

stages.name: Awakening
stages.description: The power reaches beyond the body: the ground, the walls, other people.
stages.text: The power left your body and took hold of the world around you: you had awakened.
